name: understudy
description: An agent that stands in for a user, drives a live web product, and reports back through a chosen lens.

plugins.name: understudy
plugins.description: Evaluate any web product or website as a stand-in user. Twelve lenses — ux, bugs, onboarding, content, icp, clarity, conversion, trust, technical, seo, aeo, compare — score one browser session each. Every finding cites a screenshot; icp derives three ideal customer profiles from the evidence.
